assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the CANONICAL APPROVED ASCÚA CHARACTER SHEET and is the absolute visual authority. Create an additional animation sprite atlas by posing THIS EXACT CHARACTER. Do not redesign him. Preserve his exact thick sweeping horn geometry, reptilian head/snout, amber eyes, black charcoal scales with fine ember seams, amber diamond chest core, short worn golden-ochre shoulder cape, ornate bronze forearm bracers, belt and long dark/ochre tabard, thick long tapering tail, clawed animal hands and feet, powerful adult body proportions. Same painterly 2D rendering, original lighting, palette, materials, outline treatment, camera and right-facing three-quarter view as reference. No new spikes, horns, wings, clothing, weapons, accessories, or changed anatomy. All figures face screen RIGHT. Entire body, horns, fists, feet and tail fully visible in every frame. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, sixteen unique poses in strict row-major order. Square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, all cells equal. Keep generous truly empty gutters of at least 8 percent of every cell; each character at the SAME skeletal size/scale, standing height about70 percent of the cell. Maintain a fixed virtual floor at86 percent cell height and a fixed central foot pivot; airborne frames may lift within their own cell but the virtual floor/pivot remains identical. Do NOT enlarge crouching or fallen poses to fill their cells. No overlap or crossing any cell. No cell borders or labels. Transparent PNG with REAL ALPHA: all pixels outside character silhouettes alpha0, no solid/gradient/painted-checkerboard background, no ground shadow or floor. No text, numerals, FX, dust, sparks, speed lines, external glow, explosions or background. Anatomically natural limbs with visible shoulder-elbow-wrist connections; balanced torso mechanics. This is animation continuity of the reference, never a new costume or species.
POSES row-major, exactly one per cell:
ROW1: (1) guard_shift: canonical guard, weight subtly shifted to rear leg; (2) step_back: one short backward step, guard up, rear foot moving left; (3) charge_crouch: low deliberate crouch, hips back, coiled legs, both fists tight; (4) heavy_windup: large grounded preparation, torso rotates away from opponent, striking elbow pulled back, opposite fist guarding head.
ROW2: (5) quick_windup: compact short fist retraction near ribs; (6) quick_extend: short fast rightward punch, natural bent elbow nearly extended, wrist aligned, opposite fist guards; (7) follow_through: striking arm continuing slightly forward across a rotated torso after punch; (8) recovery: fist withdrawing toward guard, hips returning balanced.
ROW3: (9) dash_lean: strong forward lean and rear leg coiled, both feet visible; (10) dash_stride: one long low forward stride, rear leg extended naturally, tail balancing, guard maintained; (11) jump_start: heel lift and leg extension beginning takeoff; (12) jump_apex: clearly airborne with knees tucked, fist prepared, same body size, feet above virtual floor.
ROW4: (13) jump_strike: airborne punch to screen right, torso turned and one knee raised, coherent arm anatomy; (14) jump_fall: descent preparation, legs unfolding toward floor, fists returning; (15) landing: knees bent absorbing landing, torso low, hands balanced; (16) guard_settle: return to exact canonical standing guard, no redundant attack pose. Meaningful readable transitions; retain all canonical costume and silhouette features in EVERY frame.
